dsh-skin-universe#dsh-web-ui-all 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH Web GUI 全家桶：带定时调度的任务看板、Git 分支图、文件与变更侧栏、支持 SFTP 与端口转发的 SSH 终端、扫码配对的手机远程控制、桌面宠物、实时 token 统计，以及五套可安装主题。

posts.en:
dsh-skin-universe#dsh-web-ui-all is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Web GUI bundle for DSH: a task board with cron scheduling, a Git branch graph, a file and change side panel, an SSH terminal with SFTP and port forwarding, QR-paired mobile remote control, a desktop companion, live token statistics, and five installable themes.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-3cbe4649b3ec15975c6c.html
